description: This Java class 'SqlDiffFileParser' is responsible for parsing an XML SQL difference file ('sqldiff.xml') from a module JAR in the OpenMRS platform. It retrieves the SQL diffs keyed by version, handling XML parsing, resource extraction from JAR files, and validation of version compatibility.

classes.name: SqlDiffFileParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing 'sqldiff.xml' files to obtain SQL differences between versions within a module JAR.

methods.name: getSqlDiffs
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the SQL diff XML file from the module JAR, returning a sorted map of version to SQL statements.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Extracts text content of a specific tag from an XML element.

methods.name: validConfigVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported configuration version strings.

methods.name: getDiffNodes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of 'diff' nodes from the XML element based on the version.
